Expression:
COUNT(from  a in db->ServiceRequests where AND(
                                  GREATEREQ(a->RegistrationDateTime_calc, $Calendarday_calc), 
                                  LESSEQ(a->RegistrationDateTime_calc, ENDOFDAY($Calendarday_calc)),
                                  EQUALS(a->Property, from b in db->PMSettings_calc where EQUALS(b->RequesterAccount_calc, USER()) select b->Property_calc)
                                  ) select a->id)
Name: Service Requests per Day
